{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Identify rows where biomarker_baseline is -999.0 (sentinel value)
invalid_rows = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] == -999.0]

# Check the severity of these invalid rows
print("Severity distribution of rows with sentinel value (-999.0) in biomarker_baseline:")
print(invalid_rows['severity'].value_counts())

# Look at the actual values for biomarker_baseline where severity is 'severe'
severe_rows = trial_df[trial_df['severity'] == 'severe']
print("\nMean biomarker_baseline for severe patients (excluding sentinel values):")
print(severe_rows[severe_rows['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline'].mean())"}
